entries: We must cross here, I am sure of it.
我们必须从这里过去，我确信。
If you stay, then so shall I.
I not turn back. This evil put home in danger.
我不回头。这邪恶威胁到了家。
Is not all evil related to our fight? Or do we seek merely to cure ourselves? This is an honest quesiton.
难道所有的邪恶都与我们的战斗无关吗？还是我们只想治好自己？这是个真心的问题。
I am in it for the treasure.
If there are jewels to be found, I shall bravely go forward.
若有珠宝可寻，我自当勇敢向前。
Baumonus... this corruption is speaking to me as well.
鲍莫努斯……这腐化也在对我低语。
There can be more than one great evil in this world. This may be unrelated to our fight. But can we just turn away?
这世上可以不止一个强大的邪恶。它也许与我们的战斗无关。可我们能就这样转身离开吗？
No surprise there. But I am in agreement.
We have faced many evil things, but this is different somehow.
我们面对过许多邪恶之物，可这一次总有些不同。
